text:
emma: Heads up — onboarding sample app is blowing up in Bun + Edge today, a couple of things confounding me. Anyone seen this combo?

liam: What errors are you seeing? runtime, stack traces?

emma: Paste from local run:
```
Error: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'subtle')
    at createKey (node_modules/@redwood-inference/js/dist/crypto.js:12:24)
    at async file:///app/src/server.ts:23:5

Also: when the SDK retries after a transient 307, auth header disappears and we get 401 on the retry.
```

anna: Which Bun/Deno/Edge image? Is this inside the edge runtime worker or plain Bun server?

emma: Bun v1.0.5, running in our edge-like sandbox (Cloudflare Workers-ish shim). Repro in a tiny CLI:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/js'; // standard quickstart import people copy from docs
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_KEY') });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'gpt-lite', input: 'hi' });
```
But the SDK import seems to assume a default export (CJS->ESM interop) and the runtime throws: "The requested module does not provide an export named 'default'" in some cases.

liam: Okay two separate but related things: webcrypto and ESM/CJS interop. For webcrypto you hit the classic "globalThis.crypto.subtle missing" in some Bun edge shims. Quick workaround in app until SDK patch:
```js
globalThis.crypto = globalThis.crypto || (await import('node-webcrypto-ossl')).crypto;
// or: globalThis.crypto = globalThis.crypto || { subtle: (await import('isomorphic-webcrypto')).subtle };
```
That gets crypto.subtle available.

liam: For the import issue, try the named import form or `import * as Redwood from '@redwood-inference/js'` as a test — our build publishes both ESM and CJS bundles and some runtimes don't do the default export shim. We'll fix the SDK to do explicit named exports to avoid ambiguity.

emma: On the retry/auth thing — I dug into the SDK fetch wrapper. We recreate the Request for retries but we were doing `new Request(req.url, { method: req.method, body: req.body })` and not copying headers. So Authorization gets dropped on retry. Minimal repro:
```js
// bad
const retryReq = new Request(req.url, { method: req.method, body: req.body });
await fetch(retryReq);
// good
const retryReq = new Request(req, { headers: new Headers(req.headers) });
await fetch(retryReq);
```
That explains the 401s.

anna: Nice find. I can put up a tiny patch to the SDK: 1) make the published ESM entry export named constructors + also include `export { default }` compat, 2) add a `safeCloneRequest` util that preserves headers/body for retries, and 3) add a small runtime check for `globalThis.crypto?.subtle` and a helpful error message pointing to polyfills.

devex-bot: ci: edge-integration/bun-tests failing (see job 4821) — failing tests 2/12, related to retry header behavior.

liam: Sweet — can you open a PR with the three changes and a tiny test that runs under Bun (mocking globalThis.crypto)? If you want I can author the webcrypto fallbacks snippet so we don't pull heavy polyfills by default.

anna: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/342 — includes safeCloneRequest, named export hygiene, and a short note in the onboarding README about Bun/Deno edge gotchas.

emma: Trying the branch now, looks promising. Thanks y'all — once merged can we add a tiny paragraph to the quickstart that mentions the Bun globalThis.crypto fallback and the import variants to try? It trips up new users during the first 10 minutes of onboarding. :pray:

liam: +1 — I'll queue the quickstart update in docs PR queue.

emma: Marking this resolved for now, reopening if anything else pops.
